title: Effects of Behavioral Stress Reduction Programs on Blood Pressure in African American Youth
brief_summary: This study will examine the effects of two behavioral stress reduction programs, mindfulness meditation (MM) and the lifeskills program (LP), and a health education control program (CTL) on blood pressure.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* In ninth grade
* SBP ranging from greater than or equal to 50th percentile to less than or equal to 95th percentile on three occasions

Exclusion Criteria:

* Clinical Hypertension
